review:
The sequel to one of BGaming's most popular games: the tiger is now a kung fu hero, there are 40 lines, and there's a Hold and Win.

In Hold and Win only sticky coins land. At the start, three multipliers (2x–5x, 10x or 15x) are dropped into empty cells, and any coin landing there gets multiplied. New coins reset the three respins. Still medium-low volatility, but the max rises to 5,000x, with a 97% RTP. A nice balance.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
